Ivy: Quick poll 10pm tonight: whos around for the buzzer-beater watch? Thinking pizza + tiny office bracket for the last-second shot. :basketball: :pizza:

Marcus: In. I will bring a folding chair and dramatic commentary.

Noah: Ill bring the HDMI and cast. Can we also do a mini bet: predict whether there will be a shot in the final 5s? $1 pot.

Keeley: $1 crown accepted. Im taking "yes". Also Ill bring extra napkins.

Ivy: Nice. Vote: 1) yes there will be a shot in last 5s, 2) no. Reply with your pick and Ill tally.

Ivy: Ivy / no / ordering pizza (half veggie). Also adding a tiebreaker: exact second of the last shot (predict mm:ss). Add your tiebreaker in the sheet.

Marcus: Love this. Also low-eff GIF bet: loser posts the best slow-motion reaction gif in #random.
